name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-06-22.277.1) introduced by the Australian Labor Party, which means they failed. ### Amendment text > *(1) Page 180 (after line 5), after clause 239A, insert:* > > *239B Review of operation of Part 7 of this Act — adult cyber abuse* > > *(1) Within 1 year after the commencement of this section, the Minister must cause to be conducted an independent review of the operation of Part 7 of this Act.* > > *(2) The Minister must cause to be prepared a written report of the review.* > > *(3) The Minister must cause copies of the report to be tabled in each House of the Parliament within 15 sitting days of that House after the day on which the report is given to the Minister.*
